laws.rule: Texting while driving is illegal for all drivers: no composing or sending texts or emails while driving (Wis. Stat. 346.89(3)). Voice-operated or hands-free use is allowed, touching the device only to switch a feature on or off. Phone-law offences bring a 4-point inattentive driving ticket and a fine.

Talking on a hand-held phone while driving through a road work zone is illegal (2015 Wisconsin Act 308, Wis. Stat. 346.89(4m)). Hands-free and Bluetooth devices are allowed, and a hand-held phone may be used to dial 911.
laws.penalty_signal: US$162.70 first offence and US$200.50 second, including court costs, as listed in 2019 (about A$231 and A$285 at RBA 30 Oct 2026, A$1 = USD 0.7040); amounts follow the Uniform Traffic Deposit Schedule and may have changed.

laws.rule: In Wisconsin state parks and forests, people of legal drinking age may bring alcohol for picnic or campsite meals, with exceptions. It is prohibited at Heritage Hill State Park, Lakeshore State Park, on observation towers, and at the McMiller Sports Center in the Kettle Moraine State Forest Southern Unit when the range is open to shooters.

Flying drones, and other flying activities such as hang gliding, parasailing, ballooning, model airplanes and skydiving, is prohibited in Wisconsin state parks, recreation areas, natural areas, the Kettle Moraine and Point Beach state forests and the Lower Wisconsin State Riverway, except where posted for their use (Wis. Adm. Code NR 45.04(1)(c)). The Richard Bong Special Use Zone is set aside for these activities and needs permission at least a week ahead. FAA rules also apply.

items.text: The drinking age is 21, but Wisconsin lets a licensed bar or restaurant serve alcohol to an underage person who is with their own parent, guardian or spouse of legal drinking age (Wis. Stat. 125.07). It is the licensee's choice: a venue can refuse. Courts have held that a parent merely being in the same venue is not enough to count as accompanying. Supplying alcohol to an unaccompanied underage person is an offence.
